description: Read every Google Ads keyword with its effective CPC bid, approval and serving status, and metrics. Returns every row rather than a first page, which is how a count taken from the console goes wrong; read-only

days.description: How many days back to report, ending today

status.description: Limit to one keyword state. Omitted, every keyword is returned with its state named, because dropping rows silently is how a count taken from this tool goes wrong the way a console count does

name: ads_keywords

bid.description: Null when Google returned no amount. A keyword under an automated bidding strategy has no CPC bid to read, which is not a bid of zero

servingStatus.description: Google's system serving status. ELIGIBLE means approved and capable of serving, not currently serving; a paused keyword reads ELIGIBLE

status.description: ENABLED, PAUSED or REMOVED. This is whether the keyword is turned on, which servingStatus does not tell you: a paused keyword still reports ELIGIBLE
